caseName: Venner v. Chicago City Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Clarence H. Venner, in Error v. The Chicago City Railway Company
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Illinois.
attorneys: Mr. John P. Wilson for defendants in error, in support of the motion., Mr. Elijah N. Zoline for plaintiff in error, in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

As it does not appear from the record that this court has jurisdiction in this case, the writ of error is dismissed for want of jurisdiction.
